description: What one robot has actually been seen doing, and the evidence for each capability: a label per capability (in production, attested by a customer or third party, shown by the manufacturer, claimed only, published failure, no evidence found) and every dated observation behind it, failures included, with source, conditions and control mode. Requires an access right on the robot requested; without it the call returns a refusal naming that robot.
name: get_robot_capabilities
title: Observed capabilities
